cards.survives_by: Gets to places others can't reach, trades what she finds
cards.starts_as: Adjacent — known and valued by local groups, not embedded
cards.note: Her trade economy requires someone to trade with. Extreme isolation breaks her.
cards.world_age_note: Addison's story needs a world 9-11 years after the Fall.

cards.one_line_identity: Big, slow, steady ex-trucker and firefighter with an axe
cards.survives_by: Breaks into buildings and clears them for food and a floor
cards.note: Strong and hard to kill up close. Slow on his feet, and lonely by habit.
cards.world_age_note: Owen's story needs a world 0-10 years after the Fall.

cards.one_line_identity: Veteran ER nurse inside a faction's clinic
cards.survives_by: Saves the ones who can be saved; the faction protects her because of it
cards.starts_as: Inside — a sworn member of a faction
cards.note: She needs the faction's medicine and its walls. Alone, she is a slow old woman.
cards.world_age_note: Ruth's story needs a world 1-10 years after the Fall.
